verdict.rationale: Mailchimp has a first-party API reference for the Marketing and Transactional APIs, with per-endpoint descriptions and request lines such as "GET https://api.mailchimp.com/3.0/". Nothing in the pack shows that reference is interactive or that its examples can be executed in-browser. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/console feature, runnable code examples across languages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
